address: Lake 6, Spine Road East, South Cerney,GL7 5FP
bio: Relax and unwind in peaceful surroundings at De Vere Cotswold Water Park. Indulge in a delicious Afternoon Tea while enjoying picturesque views of the Cotswold Water Park.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Brasserie, which provides diners with a relaxing and welcoming environment in which they can enjoy a delightful range of sweet and savoury items.  Their Afternoon Tea menu features a classic interpretation of the great British tradition including sandwiches, scones and sweet treats. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to add a glass of Prosecco or Champagne.  De Vere Cotswold Park is located in in the heart of the beautiful Cotswolds, providing guests with the opportunity the British countryside in all its glory.
